prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Japanese B2B software service landing page explanatory illustration, landscape 3:2. Create an elegant editorial illustration with precise simplified objects, subtle paper texture and restrained dimensional shading, warm off-white background, Beekle indigo #3D4DB7 and navy #001738 outlines, small cyan #00c4cc accents. Clearly readable large objects, calm professional Japanese office context. No text, no letters, no digits, no logos, no watermark. No robots, brains, glowing networks, fantasy tech or decorative floating cubes. No UI tiny illegible text; use simple bars instead. Image is an illustrative business example not an actual product screenshot. Three connected scenes flow left to right via two clear arrows. Left: neatly distinguishable manual binder, specification sheet with simple technical drawing and support-history file on office desk. Middle: an adult Japanese office worker asks a question into a search bar on monitor, three relevant documents are selected with indigo outlines, matching cyan source markers. Right: large answer panel beside two open source-document panels, worker points to highlighted source passage to verify answer. Show that AI answers from supplied sources and a person verifies the evidence. Balance all three scenes, no text.

Create a polished Japanese B2B website explanatory infographic, landscape 3:2, ultra crisp large perfectly readable Japanese typography. Off-white background, Beekle indigo #3D4DB7, navy #001738 text, cyan #00c4cc accents. Restrained editorial diagram style, generous whitespace, simple straight connectors, only large essential objects. No people, no decorative stock imagery, no fake metrics, no robots, no logo, no watermark. All text must exactly match provided Japanese strings. Organize information logically, use at most two main columns. Title「社内資料から、根拠を確かめられる回答へ」. One wide vertical flow with four distinct steps connected top to bottom: step 1「質問する」with search box「この部品は使える？」. Step 2「資料を探す」with two grouped file icons labeled「仕様書」「対応履歴」. Step 3「回答と出典を表示」with answer card and source-document connected by thin line; labels「回答案」「参照した資料」. Step 4「担当者が確認」with checkmark and label「条件と根拠を確認して使う」. Left edge has clearly aligned step numbers 1 2 3 4. Make a genuinely useful information architecture diagram, each step spans width, no horizontal multi-column cards. No other text.
